title: Insertion-Deletion Transformer
question: How much is BELU score difference between proposed approach and insertion-only method?
correct_answer: It depends on the task. Shifted alphabetic sequence task (Table 2): insertion-only 70.15 BLEU vs insertion-deletion 91.49, about 21.3 points. Caesar's cipher task (Table 3): 35.55 vs 37.57, about 2 points (the paper says 'by around 2 BLEU points').

evidence.quote: Alphabetic Sequence Shifting BLEU Insertion Model (KERMIT) 70.15 Insertion Deletion Model 91.49
the deletion model again increases the BLEU score over just the insertion model, by around 2 BLEU points. Caesar's Cipher BLEU Insertion Model (KERMIT) 35.55 Insertion Deletion Model 37.57

evidence_insufficient: a single number without the task condition, or assigning the ~21-point gain to the wrong task
flipped_relation: which task carries the large gain (paper: shifted sequences ~21.3 points, Caesar's cipher ~2.0 points; document_2 variant: swapped)
adversarial_statement: The deletion model's large gain is on the Caesar's cipher task, where BLEU rises from 70.15 to 91.49 (about 21 points); on the shifted alphabetic sequence task the deletion model adds only about 2 BLEU points (from 35.55 to 37.57).
